headline: Land Granted for 50 Years, Waiting 10 Years for Procedures: Proposal to Compensate Investors with Extra Time
summary: A proposal would compensate investors for time lost waiting for land procedures, even though land is granted for 50 years. Projects are often left with short operating periods once obstacles are cleared, reducing value.
why: Land-use rights and approval timelines are central to whether foreign and domestic investors can recover capital from projects in Vietnam.
